sources.snippet: Depth Vision Assistant is a distributed edge-AI system that turns a single camera into a depth-aware obstacle-warning device. The Raspberry Pi streams camera frames to a MacBook depth server, which returns metric (in-metres) depth, object detections, and per-object distances.
